data.name: Rename_NoName
data.value: There is no name here to rename.

data.name: Rename_NotDeclaredByWorkspace
data.value: '{0}' is not declared by the workspace: only what the workspace declares can be renamed.

data.name: Rename_Type
data.value: '{0}' is a type: renaming a module, a class, a Type or an Enum is not supported yet.

data.name: Rename_NamedByConvention
data.value: '{0}' is named after an event or an interface member that it handles or implements: renamed, it would be neither.

data.name: Rename_Event
data.value: '{0}' is an event, and its handlers are named after it: renaming an event is not supported yet.

data.name: Rename_WithEvents
data.value: '{0}' is declared WithEvents, and its handlers are named after it: renaming it is not supported yet.

data.name: Rename_Control
data.value: '{0}' is a control, which its form's designer names: renaming a control is not supported yet.

data.name: Rename_ExternalProcedure
data.value: '{0}' is an external procedure, which its library names: it cannot be renamed.

data.name: Rename_InterfaceMember
data.value: '{0}' is a member of an interface ({1}): renaming the member of an interface is not supported yet.

data.name: Rename_NotAnIdentifier
data.value: '{0}' is not a name: a name begins with a letter, and has only letters, digits and underscores.

data.name: Rename_Reserved
data.value: '{0}' is a keyword of the language: nothing can be named '{0}'.

data.name: Rename_Conflict
data.value: '{0}' already means {1} at {2}: the rename would change what the code refers to.

data.name: Rename_Unresolved
data.value: What '{0}' refers to at {2} is not known: the rename could miss it.
